scope_note: Independent visual review of receipts only. No integration, manifest, research or power changes. For each of the 13 requested slugs I viewed the native 1254px PNG, a 200px thumbnail, and targeted native crops (faces/eyes, hands and fingers, feet/hooves/talons/paws, wings, weapons, clothing opacity and background objects for pseudo-text), brightened where shadows hid anatomy, then compared them against the receipt visual_requirements and the research claims (statements and source quotes) embedded in the ledger. Before writing, each PNG SHA-256 was recomputed and matched against the receipt native_sha256, the Codex visual_review hash, the ledger item hash and the Codex root native-review hash in drafts/root/codex-native-reviews.json. Claude wrote only root_visual_review (plus correction_notes on rejects) and the receipt status, and synced only the ledger item status; the ledger was re-read immediately before writing. No PNG, Codex visual_review, Codex native review or other receipt was modified. Rejects: la-diablesse (the lower face is still a warm, friendly grin, not the documented hideous goblin-horror face); maha-sona (six nailed digits on the hand gripping the rock); majimun (two prominent webbed feet, although the embedded c04 source quote documents a one-legged duck); na-ruixa (glamour face and near-kiss embrace at golden-hour sunset read as a romance cover, not a malign capture); nightmarchers (burlap toga costume and bladed socketed spearheads foreign to ancient Hawaiian usage, and photographic living men whose ghostly hover is lost at 200px).

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and the feet/ground gap, spearheads, torches, hands, faces and cloth crops. What works: normal-size adult warrior spirits (nightmarchers-c05) with normal anatomy (one head and two eyes each; thumb plus four on the spear). They advance in ranks toward a low camera from the night surf on a lava-rock coast (c03/c04). Several carry spears, and real flaming torches burn among the ranks (c11). At native size every foreground foot clearly hovers a handspan above the wet ground, with no footprints (c06). No victims, eye beams, text or aura. It fails for three reasons. (1) The costume is invented and foreign to the tradition. c18 says the marchers are dressed 'according to ancient usage in the costume of chiefs'. Here they wear coarse, fringed, loosely woven burlap or sackcloth tied as togas over ankle-length skirts. Kapa is beaten bark cloth, not woven fabric, and this reads as a biblical-extra or costume-party robe, not ancient Hawaiian dress. (2) The spears carry separate leaf-shaped blades, metal or knapped stone, with a socket collar and binding. Hawaiian spears were one-piece hardwood. This is the same foreign-weapon problem as the r03 matuku-tangotango rejection. (3) The faces are photographic present-day men with calm, distant gazes, and the leader looks past the viewer. At 200px the hovering gaps vanish among the reflections. Nothing marks them as the deadly ghost procession (c01/c07); it reads as a torchlit beach reenactment. This is a living, sacred Native Hawaiian tradition, and the image fails the tradition-character check and Uji Sangar #2/#7.
results.correction_notes: Keep: normal-size warrior spirits marching in ranks from the night ocean onto a lava-rock shore toward the viewer (nightmarchers-c03/c04/c05). Keep real torches growing bright (c11), burning red per c18. Keep every foot clearly hovering above the ground with no footprints (c06). No victims, gore, eye beams, text or aura. Fix: (a) Costume from ancient usage (c18). Use malo loincloths and shoulder capes of smooth, beaten kapa bark cloth, not woven burlap. If chiefly costume is shown, give a feathered cloak and a crested helmet to one leading chief only. Nothing should read as a sackcloth toga, a fringed burlap robe, or Western or fantasy armour. (b) Spears: one-piece dark hardwood shafts with carved wooden points. No metal or stone blades, sockets or bindings. (c) Make them read as the dead at 200px. Paint them in the house painterly style as grave, ancient figures, not as a photographic portrait of present-day men. The leader fixes his stare directly on the viewer, since looking upon them is fatal (c07). Lift the feet so the gap is unmistakable even at 200px, for example above still water whose reflections show no disturbance, with cold mist around the legs. Keep torchlight as the one light source. No invented tattoos, glowing eyes or skeletal features.
